data.name: Forsaken
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to Forsaken, where the unholy fusion of Deckbuilding, chaotic Mini-Games, classic Card Games, and a compulsively dark Incremental Idle system collide in a symphony of terror. Dare to enter the ultimate horror Card Battler, now boasting 18 nightmare Factions and over 700 collectible cards!

Forged in the darkest abyss, Forsaken takes the card battlers you love and drags them into the depths of insanity.

Command the shambling Zombie Horde, the cunning Vampire Coven, and the twisted creations of Mad Science. Harness the raw, unknowable power of the Cult, the spectral Spirit Host, and the ancient Sea Monsters that slumber in the deep. Now featuring the chaotic Goblin swarms, the parasitic Fungal Nature, and the legendary beasts of Myth!

With over 700 distinctive cards, each seething with unholy powers and sanity-bending abilities, the strategic possibilities are truly endless. But these nightmares aren't just for show. Engage in dynamic, refined turn-based combat against cunning and malevolent AI opponents.

And when you crave a respite from the maddening abyss, a crypt of cursed mini-games awaits! Test your skills and earn precious Coins & Gems in damned classics like 9 Player Poker, Quick Poker, Pool, Blackjack, Snooker, Match 3, Chess, Checkers, Aim, Mafia, Brick Break, Space Invaders, and more!

Then, descend into the compulsively dark Incremental Idle gameplay, spending your ill-gotten gains to empower your cards, expand your domain of dread, and amplify your Star Power 💀

Key Features

  • 18 Playable Factions: Master legions of terror—from the brute force of the Werewolf Pack and the Demon Legion to the new parasitic Nature and chaotic Goblin decks!

  • 700+ Collectible Cards: Discover and unleash a nightmarish collection of creatures, spells, traps, and artifacts, each with unique abilities and stunning, macabre artwork.

  • Challenging AI Battles: Test your sanity against insidious AI opponents that learn your fears and adapt to your strategies.

  • Dynamic Turn-Based Combat: Engage in electrifying battles where strategy, skill, and a touch of madness determine your fate, with refined mechanics for faster, more brutal gameplay.

  • Deep Deck Customization: Tailor your deck with a diverse host of minions, incantations, and relics to unleash devastating new combos and forbidden synergies. Earn card packs and collect blessed cards.

  • A Full Roster of Cursed Mini-Games: Earn Coins & Gems in corrupted classics like Poker, Pool, Blackjack, Snooker, Match 3, Chess & More to fuel your dark ascension!

  • Incremental Idle Progression: Grow your power and harvest resources from the void through a satisfying and expansive idle system. Your influence grows even when you're not playing.

  • Stunning, Macabre Artwork: Immerse yourself in a world of exquisitely illustrated cards and breathtakingly grim landscapes.

  • 3+ Hour Atmospheric Soundtrack: Lose yourself in over three hours of haunting, atmospheric tunes designed to pull you deeper into the abyss.

  • 800+ Forbidden Proverbs: Unlock cryptic truths and maddening insights that will expand your mind... or shatter it completely.

  • Regular Updates & Events: Earn a daily win-of-the-day bonus of coins, xp, and gems.

  • Beginner-Friendly: Learn the dark arts with interactive tutorials, making it easy for newcomers and veterans alike to be consumed by the horror.

  • Play Solo: Hone your skills against an advanced AI that shows no mercy and preys on your weakness.

💀 Join the Ever-Growing Nightmare! 💀

Forsaken is a realm where nightmares meet strategy, malevolence meets momentum, and artistry meets agony. Recite the incantations, customize your decks, and engage in terrifying battles against worthy adversaries. Easier to learn than ever, yet profoundly challenging to master—like containing a demon while commanding an army of the damned. We keep the terror fresh, so you’ll never find peace.

The abyss is hungry. The Forsaken are waiting. What are you waiting for?
Answer the call. 🩸

data.short_description: The definitive horror Card Battler. Unleash unholy combos with 18 nightmare decks & 700+ cards. Weave soul-shattering synergies in tactical duels, survive cursed Mini-Games, and corrupt classic Card Games. Gain Star Power to harvest rewards from the abyss via deep Idle mechanics.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel i3 4th Gen / AMD FX-8300
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 1GB Video Memory
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes: Forsaken fully embraces its mature horror theme. Our card art features classic monsters—vampires, zombies, werewolves, and worse—in all their grim glory. As such, players should expect depictions of fantastical violence consistent with a dark, monstrous world.
